context: A police officer briefs on labor compliance
purpose: Teach: 時給/慣行/例会/結束/切り替える/同然/スキーム/富裕

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社の時給規定、適正です。
lines.en: Your company's hourly wage standards are compliant.
lines.style: Professional, measured delivery. Brief pause before affirming. Steady eye contact, no rush. The tone of someone checking a box but meaning it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界慣行に沿いつつ、独自運用も検討。
lines.en: Yes. We follow industry standards, but we're also exploring our own operational protocols.
lines.style: Measured, cooperative. Slight lift on 「独自運用」—pride in autonomy without defensiveness. Even pace, collaborative lean forward.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 例会の出席、社員結束に貢献していますね。
lines.en: Regular meeting attendance seems to strengthen team cohesion here.
lines.style: Observational, factual. Slight warmth underneath the procedural tone—a quiet acknowledgment of something done right. No surprise, just noting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古いやり方、新しいスキームに切り替える予定です。
lines.en: Right. We're transitioning from older practices to updated systems.
lines.style: Clear, forward-looking. Light emphasis on 「切り替える」—momentum, not apology. Tempo steady, confident. The voice of someone executing a plan.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 闇労働同然の業者、注意してください。
lines.en: Be careful about contractors operating in gray areas—near-illegal labor conditions.
lines.style: Shift to direct warning. Firm but not harsh. Slight weight on 「注意」. Measured cadence that carries seriousness without dramatics. Professional caution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 富裕層案件でも、コンプライアンス、徹底しています。
lines.en: Even with high-net-worth clients, we maintain strict compliance across the board.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Emphasis on 「徹底」—no exceptions, no shortcuts. Steady, unflinching. The assurance of someone who has already decided this is non-negotiable.
